subject: Partnering to establish Diablo Sugar Free in the {{market_short}} sugar free snacks landscape
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I'm writing from the office of the Strategy Director at Diablo Sugar Free, where I look after international partners.

{{personal_line}} We are a UK brand looking for the right partner in {{market_short}}.

By way of introduction, we are the largest sugar free confectionery company in Europe. Chocolate bars and boxed chocolates, biscuits, wafers, sweets, spreads and jams, eleven categories in all. As you'll know, sugar free carries a better margin than standard confectionery, because the shopper accepts a higher price point. We supply more than 124 countries and are listed with Carrefour, Lidl, Tesco and Holland & Barrett.

You can see our catalogue here: {{catalogue_link}}

I'd love to set up a call between myself, your team and our Strategy Director, so we can look at what the range would need to earn properly for your customers.

Would this week work, or would next week be better suited?{{booking_sentence}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
Diablo Sugar Free
{{sender_website}}
{{sender_phone}}


Diablo Sugar Free (B Healthy Ltd, London)
We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.

Privacy notice: {{privacy_url}}
